alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - Nudge popup
text: If Lausha detects many low fill levels, it uses popups to nudge the user to share their laundry to achieve higher fill levels.

alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - Community posts screen
text: Community posts are laid out clearly and only allow an interaction by requesting to join the share, avoiding users potentially getting messaged inappropriately.

alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - Creating a post screen
text: The user is guided through creating a post with design constraints, only including relevant information and making the process very straight-forward.

alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - My shares scren
text: Guidance prompts within the app increase user confidence and trust.

alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - User profile screen
text: A user's profile only includes relevant information, focusing on the ratings they received to foster user trust and avoid bad laundry sharing experiences as much as possible.
